capabilities: Generate coats of arms deterministically from a name or seed, or roll random named results
Build arms manually with shield shapes, tinctures, furs, ordinaries, counterchanging, and flags
Save arms to a searchable library and find unused entries by scanning notes
Embed arms in notes as interactive or static blocks and sized inline images, including inside tables
Import custom SVG and WMF artwork as charges, ordinaries, shields, fields, variations, and furs
extras: Free plugin; bundled charge pack and any bundled assets carry CC BY 3.0 attribution duties (CREDITS.md). EPS vector files are not supported for import — use WMF or SVG. Custom name-source scripts can call any plugin's API via a Connector plugin id.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create, store, or display coats of arms for worldbuilding and TTRPG campaign notes.

relations.evidence: api is bound to the .api of the plugin named in Connector plugin id (default randomness)
an optional bundled charge pack — ~28 fantasy charges (lion, eagle, wolf, dragon, castle, ship, crown, and more) from game-icons.net

summary: Coat-of-arms designer and procedural generator that saves heraldry to a library and embeds it in notes as blocks or inline SVG/PNG images.
